calls.video_title: DON'T Miss The Next Indian Stock Market Bull-Run In 2027 ! - Where to Invest? | Rahul Jain
calls.thesis: Particularly bullish long-term: Nifty 50 fell ~15% then ~10% in 2026 on the oil-crisis panic, but the long-term trend is intact (~12% compounding over 20 years; 15-20% intra-year falls are normal) and 2027 looks bullish on earnings + valuations + cooling oil
calls.base_case: Morgan Stanley base case: Sensex 95,000 by Dec 2027 (50% probability) if the India-US trade deal lands and Brent stays below $100
calls.bull_case: Sensex beyond 1,05,000 (30% probability) if oil drops below $75, inflation eases and reforms plus stronger earnings growth land
calls.bear_case: Sensex back to 68,000 if oil goes above $100 a barrel
calls.flip: HOLD -> BUY (prev HOLD 27 Sep 2026, video kJuk2TsBfaI)

calls.video_title: Where to Invest and where NOT TO? - Indian stocks vs US stocks vs Gold vs FDs  - Rahul Jain
calls.thesis: Down ~11% YTD with EPS growth only ~3.9%; cautious until oil stabilizes and yields cool - continue SIPs, take no high-risk bets
calls.bull_case: Oil stabilizes around $65-75 and yields cool, bull run resumes
calls.bear_case: Oil stays ~$98-100 and 30Y yields stay at all-time highs, Nifty sinks further
